description: The donut-style pie chart titled “Stimulus Type” shows the distribution of input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, and it contains 10 slices with percentage labels placed outside the ring (no separate legend is shown). The categories and approximate proportions are: Draft/Other in dark red at 26.4%, Press Release in mustard yellow at 18.7%, External News Article in dark green at 18.1%, Interview in dark navy at 8.8%, Organizational Report in purple at 7.7%, Event Posting in maroon at 6.6%, Organizational Website in light lavender at 4.9%, Intra-agency news article in medium blue at 4.9%, Email in light green at 2.7%, and Social Media Post in a very small light orange/yellow slice at 1.1%. No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments are arranged around the ring without an explicitly indicated ordering scheme.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of input stimulus material types provided by journalists to large language models (LLMs) during WildChat interactions, subsequently matched to published articles from two prominent news agencies. The data reveals ten distinct categories, with the 'Draft/Other' category dominating at approximately 26.4%. The 'Press Release' and 'External News Article' categories follow, comprising 18.7% and 18.1% of the total, respectively. Notably, the 'Interview' category, accounting for 12.3%, consistently surpassed the 'Organizational Report' segment, which stabilized at around 5.5%. The 'Event Posting' category, depicted in red, represents 6.6%, while the 'Organizational Website' and 'Intra-agency news article' categories each contribute roughly 4.9%. The 'Email' category constitutes 2.7%, and the 'Social Media Post' category, shown in light yellow, remains the smallest at 1.1%. The distribution highlights a marked preference for press releases and external news articles over intra-agency materials, with interviews and organizational reports exhibiting minimal fluctuation in their relative proportions.
